chapters.line_en: 38 rejections and a first commission cheque of RM 128. Finding the why that everything else is built on.
chapters.line_zh: 38次拒絕，第一張佣金支票只有RM 128。找到撐起一切的「為什麼」。
chapters.book_en: 38 rejections and a first commission cheque of RM 128. How finding your deepest 'why' through the Ikigai framework becomes the foundation everything else is built on.
chapters.book_zh: 38次拒絕，第一張佣金支票只有RM 128。如何透過Ikigai框架找到你最深層的「為什麼」，奠定一切的根基。

chapters.line_en: A RM 13,500 lesson in market research, and why knowing your weaknesses matters more than your strengths.
chapters.line_zh: 一堂學費RM 13,500的市場研究課，以及為什麼認清弱點比認清優勢更重要。
chapters.book_en: A RM 13,500 lesson in market research. SWOT analysis, the half-face experiment, and why understanding your weaknesses matters more than your strengths.
chapters.book_zh: 一堂花了RM 13,500的市場研究課。SWOT分析、半臉實驗，以及為什麼認清弱點比認清優勢更重要。

chapters.line_en: Seven specific actions, every day, for 90 days.
chapters.line_zh: 7項具體動作，每天執行，持續90天。
chapters.book_en: The DMO (Daily Method of Operation) — 7 specific actions, done every day for 90 days. Why most new partners stay busy without results, and what changes when the day is built around the actions that count.
chapters.book_zh: DMO（每日行動模式）：7項具體動作，每天執行，持續90天。為什麼很多新人很忙卻沒有結果，以及把時間花在真正會帶來結果的行動上之後，會有什麼不同。

chapters.line_en: From about 5% to about 70% with one framework: FORMHD.
chapters.line_zh: 一個框架，讓成功率從大約5%提升到大約70%：FORMHD。
chapters.book_en: From about 5% to about 70% success rate with one framework. How the FORMHD method turns spray-and-pray into precision targeting.
chapters.book_zh: 一個框架讓成功率從大約5%提升到大約70%。FORMHD方法如何把亂槍打鳥變成精準出擊。

chapters.line_en: One bad invitation nearly cost a friendship of many years.
chapters.line_zh: 一次糟糕的邀約，差點毀了一段多年的友誼。
chapters.book_en: How one bad invitation nearly cost me a friendship of many years — and the 'ask for opinion' technique that took my acceptance rate from about 15% to 80%.
chapters.book_zh: 一次糟糕的邀約，差點毀了一段多年的友誼。以及「請教意見」技巧如何把接受率從大約15%拉到80%。

chapters.line_en: 60 slides, 2 hours, nothing sold. Then 8 slides, mostly listening, and 2 of 3 bought.
chapters.line_zh: 60張投影片、2小時，沒有人買。後來改用8張、大部分時間在聽，3個人裡2個當場買了。
chapters.book_en: 60 slides, 2 hours, nothing sold. Then Irene tried 8 slides and mostly listened, and 2 of 3 bought on the spot. How to replace a lecture with a conversation.
chapters.book_zh: 60張投影片、2小時、沒有人買。後來Irene改用8張投影片，大部分時間在聽，3個人裡2個當場買了。如何用對話取代演講。

chapters.line_en: She threw him out of her house. A few visits later, Aunty Lim bought the whole set.
chapters.line_zh: 她把他趕出門。去了幾次之後，Aunty Lim整套產品當場付清。
chapters.book_en: She threw me out of her house. A few visits with fruit and nasi lemak later, Aunty Lim asked me in, bought the whole set, and had two friends waiting when I delivered it. The 1-4-7 golden follow-up method.
chapters.book_zh: 她把我趕出門。帶著水果和椰漿飯去了幾次之後，Aunty Lim請我進門，整套產品當場付清，送貨那天還約了兩位朋友在家等我。1-4-7黃金跟進法。

chapters.line_en: The first three days decide whether a new partner becomes a diamond or a shooting star.
chapters.line_zh: 前三天，決定新夥伴成為「鑽石」還是「流星」。
chapters.book_en: Chris quit because I said 'good luck.' Sarah thrived because of the 72-hour activation system. Tell-Show-Try-Do — the four-step coaching method.
chapters.book_zh: Chris放棄了，因為我只說了「祝好運」。Sarah成功了，因為72小時啟動系統。講-做-試-放，四步教練法。

chapters.book_en: I taught Kevin everything in 3 hours. He quit. Then I learned: training is activation, not education. The hand-holding system, and why your time belongs with the few who have real potential.
chapters.book_zh: 我花3小時教完Kevin所有東西。他放棄了。後來我才學到：培訓是啟動，不是灌輸。手把手系統，以及為什麼要把時間投資在那少數最有潛力的人身上。

chapters.line_en: A 90-day goal of 50. 44 people by day 90. The Five Virtues of a General.
chapters.line_zh: 90天目標50人，第90天招募到第44位夥伴。將者五德。
chapters.book_en: A 90-day goal of 50. 44 recruits in 90 days. When his team stalled, Leon stopped managing and went back to the front line. The Five Virtues of a General: wisdom, trust, benevolence, courage, discipline.
chapters.book_zh: 90天目標50人，最後親自招募了44位夥伴。當團隊停滯，Leon不再只做管理，重新回到市場一線。將者五德：智、信、仁、勇、嚴。

chapters.line_en: RM 1,600 flight. 100 interested people. Zero results. Then Seremban.
chapters.line_zh: RM 1,600的機票，100個「有興趣」的人，零結果。直到芙蓉。
chapters.book_en: RM 1,600 flight. 100 'interested' people. Zero results. Then: Samantha in Seremban, whose team's results caught up with Kuala Lumpur's within a year. The 'show me small results first' philosophy.
chapters.book_zh: RM 1,600的機票。100個「有興趣」的人。零結果。直到芙蓉的Samantha，一年後業績追上了吉隆坡。「先做出小成果給我看」的哲學。

chapters.line_en: 5 of 7 core leaders left in one month. How Vivian's team came back stronger.
chapters.line_zh: 一個月內7位核心走了5位。Vivian的團隊如何比危機前更強。
chapters.book_en: 5 of 7 core leaders left in one month. The call Vivian made to me that night, the crisis management 5-step method, and how her team came back stronger than before.
chapters.book_zh: 一個月內7位核心走了5位。Vivian那晚打給我的電話、危機處理五步法，以及她的團隊如何比危機前更強。

chapters.line_en: Build a business that runs without you every day, and get your time back.
chapters.line_zh: 建立一個不依賴你日常運作的事業，把時間還給自己。
chapters.book_en: You built the business, and now you're busier than ever. The art of letting go — overcoming 4 psychological barriers to build a business that runs without you every day, and getting your time back.
chapters.book_zh: 事業建起來了，你卻比以前更忙。學會放手，突破4個心理關卡，建立一個不依賴你日常運作的事業，把時間還給自己。
